description: This file defines the VacancyDecorator class within the OrangeHRM recruitment plugin, providing methods to manipulate Vacancy objects such as setting related JobTitle and Employee entities by ID and checking vacancy status.

classes.name: VacancyDecorator
classes.description: A decorator class that provides additional methods to manipulate Vacancy entities, such as setting related entities by ID and checking vacancy status.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that associates a Vacancy instance to this decorator.

methods.name: setJobTitleById
methods.description: Sets the JobTitle of the associated Vacancy using a given ID.

methods.name: getVacancy
methods.description: Returns the current Vacancy object associated with this decorator.

methods.name: setEmployeeById
methods.description: Sets the hiring manager (Employee) of the associated Vacancy using a given ID.

methods.name: isActiveAndPublished
methods.description: Checks if the Vacancy is both published and has an active status.
